column1: # Ivan's observations during Ash Jenna's confrontation and the Altin rescue.

column3: She wants a witness,\nnot just an ally.\nIt doesn't make her right.{end_wait}
The water is rising fast.\nWe need to move the rubble\nbefore it reaches them.{end_wait}
The desert can wait.\nShe asked for a moment.\nLet's give her one.{end_wait}
